description: This source file implements ethtool-related functions for a network driver specific to Ralink Ethernet hardware, providing interfaces to get and set link settings, driver info, message level, ring parameters, and statistics.

methods.name: int fe_get_link_ksettings(struct net_device * ndev,struct ethtool_link_ksettings * cmd)
methods.description: Retrieves the link settings from the PHY device, verifying the device and its status before copying settings.

methods.name: int fe_set_link_ksettings(struct net_device * ndev,const struct ethtool_link_ksettings * cmd)
methods.description: Sets the link settings on the PHY device, handling physical address changes and device attachment or detachment accordingly.

methods.name: void fe_get_drvinfo(struct net_device * dev,struct ethtool_drvinfo * info)
methods.description: Fills in driver information such as driver name, version, and bus info.

methods.name: u32 fe_get_msglevel(struct net_device * dev)
methods.description: Returns the current message level (verbosity level) for debugging or informational messages.

methods.name: void fe_set_msglevel(struct net_device * dev,u32 value)
methods.description: Sets the message level to control logging verbosity.

methods.name: int fe_nway_reset(struct net_device * dev)
methods.description: Restarts auto-negotiation on the PHY device.

methods.name: u32 fe_get_link(struct net_device * dev)
methods.description: Returns the current link status, updating link info if needed.

methods.name: int fe_set_ringparam(struct net_device * dev,struct ethtool_ringparam * ring,struct kernel_ethtool_ringparam * kernel_rp,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Configures the transmit and receive ring buffer sizes for the network device.

methods.name: void fe_get_ringparam(struct net_device * dev,struct ethtool_ringparam * ring,struct kernel_ethtool_ringparam * kernel_rp,struct netlink_ext_ack * extack)
methods.description: Retrieves current ring buffer sizes and maximum capabilities.

methods.name: void fe_get_strings(struct net_device * dev,u32 stringset,u8 * data)
methods.description: Provides string descriptions for statistics, based on requested string set.

methods.name: int fe_get_sset_count(struct net_device * dev,int sset)
methods.description: Returns the number of statistic strings available for a given statistic set.

methods.name: void fe_get_ethtool_stats(struct net_device * dev,struct ethtool_stats * stats,u64 * data)
methods.description: Collects and reports hardware statistics for the network device.

methods.name: void fe_set_ethtool_ops(struct net_device * netdev)
methods.description: Assigns the ethtool operations to the network device, including optional statistics functions.
